prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one square transparent 2x2 atlas of FOUR separate website illustrations. Style: premium richly detailed hand-painted storybook collectibles, precise contours, layered realistic textures, subtle dimensional shading, elegant and playful rather than childish. Match the collection of ornate midnight clocks with satin bows, natural rabbits with painted eggs, antique floral watering cans, and detailed black cats on glowing pumpkins. No cartoon faces. Each subject fits entirely inside its quadrant at only 70% of cell width/height. Leave a fully transparent cross gutter of 10% total canvas width, clear outer margins, no overlap, no subject or ribbon crossing any quadrant boundary. Four independent illustrations, no connected scene, no ground shadows. Genuine transparent alpha in every gap. No backdrop, checkerboard, frame, labels, words, or watermark. Crisp detailed silhouettes for small display. Theme: relaxed general summer, ocean teal and coral with warm ivory, natural straw and subtle gold details. Top left: elegant woven straw sunhat with a coral satin bow, teal sunglasses and a small hibiscus flower, arranged as one compact vignette. Top right: tall glass of lemonade with lemon slices, mint and a coral striped straw, beside one whole lemon. Bottom left: small beautifully crafted teal and ivory wooden sailboat with a coral pennant, no water or base. Bottom right: a small arrangement of a spiral seashell, a scallop shell, a natural starfish, and a coral-colored hibiscus. Four unique objects, upright, not tilted as a whole.
